sources.title: Lagos, Nigeria Metro Area Population (1950-2026) - Macrotrends

output.findings:
The metro area population of Lagos, Nigeria, is estimated to be approximately 17.8 million in 2026. This reflects a continued upward trend in metropolitan growth.

The annual growth rate for Lagos is currently estimated at 3.78% for 2026. This follows an annual growth rate of 3.75% in 2025 and 3.70% in 2024, indicating a sustained, high-paced expansion of the city's urban population.

Arab Republic of Egypt - Informatics bulletin monthly June 2025

output.findings:
Estimates for Cairo's population vary significantly depending on whether the data refers to the city proper or the broader metropolitan area. Macrotrends reports the Cairo metro area population in 2026 at approximately 23.5 million, reflecting a year-over-year growth rate of 2.0%.

Other sources, including some referencing official Egyptian statistical data, provide lower figures for the city proper, often in the range of 10 million to 11 million. These sources may report lower annual growth rates, such as approximately 1.07% for the city administrative area, highlighting the discrepancy between urban core statistics and metropolitan region projections.
